newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering seeks to raise return on sales.
newsitem.headline: Schering seeks to raise return on sales.

text.p: A top official of Schering AG said on Wednesday the German pharmaceuticals group was seeking to raise its return on sales to 10 percent by 2000 from the current level of seven percent.

Schering deputy management board chairman Klaus Pohle told the Zurich newspaper "Finanz und Wirtschaft" that Schering was also seeking to boost its own capital to 14 percent from 10 percent in the same time period.
Pohle also reaffirmed Schering's outlook for profits to be 10 to 15 percent higher for the year and for sales to climb to six billion marks ($3.4 billion).
He also reaffirmed that it was possible Schering would pay a higher dividend for the year.
